title: The Waffler
description: According to urban legend, on the creepy house on the hill, lives The Waffler, a monster who eats people as part of a balanced breakfast.
altHero: the Waffler, a green monster man, about to eat a man whose face has been waffled
alt1: a couple terrified as the the Waffler approaches them
alt3: man whose face has been waffled
alt4: the Waffler pouring syrup on the guy’s face
